items.en: Ukrainian FPV commander recalls drone kill on Russian UR-77 mine-clearer carrying over two tons of explosives
items.nl: Oekraïense FPV-commandant blikt terug op droneaanval op Russische UR-77-mijnenruimer met ruim twee ton explosieven
items.sEn: "Skipper", an FPV company commander in Ukraine's 413th Raid Unmanned Systems Regiment, told Army TV that his proudest strike was destroying a Russian UR-77 mine-clearing vehicle with a cheap FPV drone during Ukraine's 2023 counteroffensive.
